principle: Correlated artifacts from one research lineage are not counted as independent support. Remove whole provenance families and ask which manuscript claims survive.

F1_EARLY_OPERATOR_FAILURES.role: early counterexamples: exact-local redundancy and full-state reversal
F1_EARLY_OPERATOR_FAILURES.ablation_effect: Central observation-operator thesis survives via later phase-quotient/Roux failures and G4 unseen transport, but the paper loses its cleanest intuitive examples showing that superficially plausible behavioral signals can fail construct courts.
F1_EARLY_OPERATOR_FAILURES.manuscript_action: Retain at least one early failure in main text; move detailed R1.7 filter cascade to supplement.

F2_QUOTIENT_AND_TRANSPORT.role: phase-specific quotient geometry, attempt-level multiplicity, method-specific transport
F2_QUOTIENT_AND_TRANSPORT.ablation_effect: Trace-not-self-interpreting thesis survives through early failures and Roux lineage, but the general methodological obligations around multiplicity and future-scale transport become much less directly evidenced.
F2_QUOTIENT_AND_TRANSPORT.manuscript_action: Keep one compact statistical-method section; do not drown main text in gate details.

F3_ROUX_G1_G2_MEASUREMENT.role: annotation endpoint failure, center/color frame failure, discovery of prefix-identifiable route gauge
F3_ROUX_G1_G2_MEASUREMENT.ablation_effect: G4 positive endpoint still exists mechanically, but the explanatory bridge from failed method semantics to prefix gauge/ontology becomes under-motivated and risks appearing posthoc.
F3_ROUX_G1_G2_MEASUREMENT.manuscript_action: Retain SB/center failures as the key semantic/frame falsification transition.

F4_ROUX_G3_G4.role: rotation algebra stress test, canonical ontology, canonical null, development-unseen transport
F4_ROUX_G3_G4.ablation_effect: The paper loses its strongest positive endpoint and becomes a predominantly negative methodological paper about failed observation operators. The central falsification thesis remains coherent, but the statement that a later frozen operator transported out of development no longer survives.
F4_ROUX_G3_G4.manuscript_action: Declare the positive transport conclusion lineage-dependent and never count R1.13/R1.14 sub-artifacts as multiple independent replications.

cross_family_conclusion.recommended_evidence_wording: The manuscript is supported by a serial falsification lineage plus one frozen development-unseen ontology transport court, not by eight independent studies.
